title: Irresponsible Parents Leave Lifeless Toddler On Family's Doorstep
description:
On July 10th, 2021.  Police responded to a harrowing situation regarding a lifeless toddler found at a grandparent's doorstep. Police discovered that the baby was dropped off by the parents and drove off immediately, forcing the grandparent to drive the baby to the hospital.

You can read more about this case here: https://cbs12.com/news/local/toddler-may-have-been-dead-for-days-coroner-says
